propositions: The bridge fsck module advertises three phantom checks (orphaned, duplicates, stale) that depend on legacy SYNC events never written by rebar and thus always return empty results.
Forward and reverse binding indexes in bindings.json are not verified for consistency during fsck, allowing mismatches between forward bindings and their reverse counterparts to go undetected.

Unknown event types are currently detected via a full Python JSON walk; the scan should instead use a checkout-free two-stage git grep against refs/heads/tickets to avoid materializing the tickets tree.

The phantom SYNC output cells and their associated infrastructure (_STALE_THRESHOLD_NS, _NS_THRESHOLD, --now-ts, SYNC-only fixtures) must be removed from the structured output, CLI, MCP schema, and all consumers.

Store integrity findings must be produced as six specific check kinds (forward_missing_jira_key, forward_missing_reverse, forward_reverse_mismatch, reverse_missing_forward, reverse_nonconfirmed_forward, reverse_jira_key_mismatch) with fail-closed semantics, while unknown_event_types remains informational.
